facts.fact: The arboretum has a main gate near Kenya Girl Guide Headquarters and a lower gate in Kileleshwa.
facts.evidenceExcerpt: The main gate, next Kenya Girl Guide Headquarters ... Lower gate in Kileleshwa

facts.fact: Visitor guidance asks people to stay on designated tracks, keep quiet, avoid feeding wildlife and leave plants undisturbed.
facts.evidenceExcerpt: Do not feed wild animals. ... Keep to the designated tracks and paths when walking.

facts.fact: Payments are cashless according to its visitor information.
facts.evidenceExcerpt: All payments are via the MPESA/AIRTEL E-Citizen Platform or Bank/Swipe Cards . Cash payments are not accepted
